backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profiles, ML health predictions, medical file storage, and access control with authorization mixins for users and admins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four requirements for expanding the medical knowledge base with menstrual cycle, pregnancy, and women's health condition information.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, utilities, and configuration for the healthcare app with Design B theme system.
frontend/DEPLOY_NOTES.md: Deployment fix documentation explaining resolution of Vite environment variable issues and duplicate provider nesting by creating frontendEnv.ts utility and consolidating providers in App.tsx.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS with OKLCH color system defining CSS variables for default and dark themes including sidebar, chart, and Design B color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Mobile Health Care App with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with all routes, wrapping providers (ThemeProvider, DesignBProvider, QueryClient, InternetIdentity) and rendering DesignBAppShell layout with Toaster.
frontend/src/auth/demoCredentialStore.ts: LocalStorage-based demo account management with phone number uniqueness enforcement, password hashing, account creation, and credential verification functions.
frontend/src/auth/demoCredentialTypes.ts: TypeScript type definitions for DemoAccount, VerifyCredentialsResult, and CreateAccountResult used in phone/password authentication flow.
frontend/src/auth/session.ts: Manages local authentication sessions (OTP, password, guest) in localStorage with 30-day expiration, providing save/load/clear/validate functions.
frontend/src/components/assistant/assist: Command interpreter using pattern matching and fuzzy string matching to route user input to navigation, medical knowledge, report analysis, or help responses.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Assist: React component rendering the assistant chat UI with speech recognition, text-to-speech, transcript display, message formatting, and confidence indicators.
frontend/src/components/assistant/assist: Handles localStorage persistence and migration of assistant conversation transcripts with versioning support (v1 to v2 migration).
TypeScript type definitions for assistant messages, states, command results, confidence levels, and report analysis context.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Assist: Main assistant widget component managing conversation state, command interpretation, report analysis flow, and integration with medical files and navigation.
frontend/src/components/assistant/medica: Curated medical knowledge base containing structured information about blood pressure, diabetes, and other health topics with symptoms, precautions, and emergency guidance.
frontend/src/components/assistant/report: Provides deterministic, pattern-based analysis of medical report text, extracting key findings, interpretations, suggested actions, and red flags without using AI/LLM.
Extracts plain text from file bytes for text-based formats (txt, csv, json, etc.), validating that decoded content is not binary garbage.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useAss: React hook managing assistant conversation transcript state, persisting messages to storage and providing add/clear operations.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useSpe: React hook wrapping browser SpeechRecognition API with retry logic, confidence scoring, error handling, and interim/final transcript tracking.
React hook for text-to-speech using browser SpeechSynthesis API with enable/disable toggle and speaking state management.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useTra: React hook providing auto-scroll behavior for transcript containers, detecting user scroll position and scrolling to bottom when new messages arrive.
frontend/src/designB/components/Dashboar: Reusable dashboard section header component with title, optional caption, and action slot.
Interactive dashboard tile component with icon, label, value, color accents, hover effects, and optional close button for active state.
frontend/src/designB/components/DesignBS: Surface container component with three variants (default, elevated, outlined) for consistent card-like styling.
frontend/src/designB/components/DesignBT: Typography components (PageTitle, SectionTitle, Caption, BodyText) providing consistent text styling across Design B.
frontend/src/designB/components/ThemeSwi: Toggle switch component for switching between default and Design B themes using theme context.
frontend/src/designB/data/placeholders.t: Defines UserProfile interface and exports a mock user profile generated with a fixed seed for consistent demo data.
frontend/src/designB/layout/DesignBAppSh: Main app shell component for Design B theme with sticky header showing logo/branding, conditional user display name, theme switcher, bottom navigation tabs, assistant widget, and footer with attribution.
frontend/src/designB/layout/DesignBBotto: Fixed bottom navigation bar component with tabs for Home, Reports, and Profile routes, highlighting the active tab.
frontend/src/designB/storage/themePrefer: Utility functions to save and load theme preference ('default' or 'designB') from localStorage.
frontend/src/designB/theme.ts: Defines Design B theme constants (colors, fonts, spacing, radius) and functions to apply/remove the theme by setting data-design-theme attribute on document root.
frontend/src/designB/themeContext.tsx: React context provider and hook for managing Design B theme state, persisting preference to localStorage and applying theme attribute to document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthSession.ts: Hook for managing local authentication session state including OTP, password-based, and guest sign-in methods with session validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useDemoOtp.ts: Hook providing demo OTP generation, verification with expiry/cooldown logic, and session management for phone-based authentication flow.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY AuthClient, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useMedicalFiles.ts: Hook providing queries and mutations for medical file management including listing metadata, uploading files as ExternalBlob, deleting files, and downloading/retrieving file bytes.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains query hooks for backend data fetching, including useGetCallerUserProfile for fetching current user profile via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useRedirectIfAuthenti: Hook that redirects authenticated users (via Internet Identity or local session) from public pages to /home.
frontend/src/hooks/useRequireAuth.ts: Route guard hook that redirects unauthenticated users to /signin by checking both Internet Identity and local session state (OTP, password, guest).
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDisplayName.ts: Hook that resolves a display name for the current user with priority order: saved profile name, local session name/phone, guest label, shortened principal, or fallback to 'Guest'.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file importing fonts (Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter) and defining Tailwind layers with extensive CSS custom properties for theming (light/dark modes and designB theme variant).
frontend/src/lib/flaker.ts: Deterministic fake data generator using seeded PRNG to create realistic demo user profiles including names, emails, phones, blood types, allergies, and emergency contacts.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility module exporting a `cn` function that merges Tailwind classes using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AppointmentDetails.ts: Empty file placeholder for appointment details page component.
frontend/src/pages/Chatbot.tsx: Protected chatbot page with medical assistant functionality including command interpretation, report analysis workflow, file text extraction, and conversational transcript management.
frontend/src/pages/DoctorList.tsx: Empty file placeholder for doctor list page component.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboard.tsx: Protected home dashboard displaying health metrics (heart rate, hydration, sleep, steps) and quick action tiles for navigation to chatbot, reports, and other features.
frontend/src/pages/Locate.tsx: Empty file placeholder for locate page component.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundRedirect.tsx: Component that redirects 404/removed routes to /home using useEffect and TanStack Router navigation.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Profile page component that displays and allows editing of user personal information, medical details, and emergency contacts. Includes sign-out functionality and uses Internet Identity authentication with local session management.
frontend/src/pages/Report.tsx: Medical reports management page that allows authenticated users to upload, download, and delete medical files. Displays file list with metadata (size, date) and includes confirmation dialogs for deletions.
frontend/src/pages/SignIn.tsx: Sign-in page with three authentication methods: Internet Identity, OTP-based phone verification, and password-based phone login. Includes guest mode and redirects authenticated users automatically.
frontend/src/pages/SignUp.tsx: Account creation page that collects full name, phone number, and password to create a new account. Initializes local profile with sign-up details and signs in the user upon successful registration.
frontend/src/pages/Welcome.tsx: Landing page displaying healthcare branding, hero image, and feature highlights. Provides navigation to sign-in or guest mode exploration with automatic redirect for authenticated users.
frontend/src/profile/profileBackendMappe: Utility module for bidirectional mapping between frontend ProfileDetails and backend UserProfile types. Includes converters for blood type enums and date/bigint timestamp transformations.
frontend/src/profile/profileLocalStore.t: Manages localStorage persistence for user profile data, keyed by phone number (for password/OTP sessions) or stable guest ID (for guest sessions). Provides functions to load, save, clear, and initialize profiles from auth-captured details.
frontend/src/profile/profileTypes.ts: Defines the ProfileDetails interface (full name, email, phone, date of birth, blood type, allergies, emergency contact, location) and utility functions to create empty profiles and check if profile data exists.
frontend/src/profile/profileValidation.t: Validates ProfileDetails fields (required full name, email format, phone format, emergency contact completeness) and returns a ValidationResult with boolean validity and array of human-readable error messages.
frontend/src/profile/useProfileDetails.t: React hook that provides profile details and save mutation, handling both Internet Identity (backend API) and local sessions (localStorage) with React Query for caching and state management.
Manages localStorage persistence for medical file metadata indexed by file ID. Deprecated for listing purposes; backend metadata API is now the source of truth, but local metadata is kept for backward compatibility.
frontend/src/utils/frontendEnv.ts: Provides frontend environment configuration utilities to safely read Vite build-time environment variables, specifically for retrieving the Internet Identity provider URL with fallback to production.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for parsing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to clear sensitive parameters from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, font families (Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans), container settings, border radius variables, custom shadows, and keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking for a medical chatbot application with expanded knowledge base covering general health, women's health issues (menstruation, pregnancy, PCOS, endometriosis, PMS, menopause). Contains four completed features related to menstrual cycle information, pregnancy guidance, and common women's health conditions.
